name: Blue Nerdz Deli
description: Lineage: Blue sherb (Blue cookies x sunset sherb) x Nerdz Type: Hybrid Terpenes: β-Myrcene, Limonene, Linalool Effects: Focused,Relaxed Aroma: Apple, Blueberry, Apricot Blue Nerdz is a nostalgic throwback to tangy blue raspberry candies. This indica-dominant strain brings a sweet and sour flavor profile, paired with an energetic high that’s perfect for focus. It’s a favorite for stress relief without leaving you couch-locked.
